Variable.name: soundDirs
Variable.doc: List of directories scanned for sound sets. Set before :start() to customize. Defaults to bundled sounds/, ~/Music/Klonk/keyboard, and legacy fallbacks. Earlier directories win.

Method.name: start
Method.doc: Installs the menu-bar item and the keystroke listener, restoring the last set / volume / on-state.

Method.name: stop
Method.doc: Removes the menu-bar item and stops listening.

Method.name: toggle
Method.doc: Toggles keyboard, mouse, and ambient sounds together without forgetting their selections.

Method.name: cycleSet
Method.doc: Switches to the next (step 1) or previous (step -1) sound set.

Method.name: bindHotkeys
Method.doc: Binds hotkeys. Keys: toggle, toggleMouse, togglePresenter, nextSet, prevSet, settings.

Method.name: showSettings
Method.doc: Opens the graphical settings window. Optional section: tools. Settings apply immediately and persist through the existing engine.

name: Klonk
desc: Mechanical keystroke sounds for macOS — any sound set is a folder of WAVs.
doc: Mechanical keystroke sounds for macOS, in any voice you like. A sound set is just a folder of WAVs, so synthesized sets, real recorded keyboards, and anything you drop in all play the same way. Each set can give Return its own flourish through enter.wav. Menu-bar controlled.
